lede: The biggest thing to watch this week is Telluride Town Council's Tuesday meeting, where the Colorado Wildfire Resiliency Code goes to third reading — a final vote that would amend land use, historic review standards, and landscaping rules for property owners across town. Also worth your attention: San Miguel County Planning Commission meets Thursday with a subdivision work session and an energy code update affecting new construction on the agenda. On the lighter side, the Jazz Festival is rolling, Ridgway Rendezvous wraps up the weekend, and Movies Under the Stars lands Sunday night.

notable.stake: Final vote on wildfire code that reshapes land use and landscaping rules.
County subdivision mechanics and energy code update for new construction reviewed.
